title: Grace period contradicts MUST NOT access for non-members
description: Section 4 states that non-members MUST NOT be granted access to the Space file tree. Section 6 allows a grace period during which former Space members MAY continue to access files after Space destruction. Once a Space is destroyed, former members are non-members, so the grace period directly violates the Section 4 MUST NOT. Either carve out an explicit exception in Section 4 for the grace period, or reconcile the two.
